A New Chapter for Uttar Pradesh: Education to Opportunity

Meeting with Hon’ble Chief Minister, Uttar Pradesh
5, Kalidas Marg, Lucknow | 13 September 2026

Today, I had the privilege of participating in a review meeting chaired by Hon’ble Chief Minister Shri Yogi Adityanath Ji on the progress of Uttar Pradesh State Institute of Forensic Science (UPSIFS), Lucknow.

Hon’ble Chief Minister has kindly consented to grace our International Summit 2026 as Chief Guest on 24 October.

Scheduled for 23–25 October 2026, the Summit will connect 1200+ policymakers, industry, legal professionals and academia from India and abroad to advance a cyber-resilient, legally compliant and future-ready Uttar Pradesh.

Prominent industry tycoons, professionals, academicians, legal luminaries will immensely contribute in this Knowledge Sangam.

Multiple MoUs to be signed with the National and International organisations such as SANS Institute and University of Indianapolis.

23 October: Industry–student engagement focused on skills, training and pathways to employment.

24 October: The principal Summit, bringing leadership, industry and academia together for partnerships and purposeful dialogue.

25 October: Charting a sustained framework for policy–industry–academia collaboration.

At its heart is UPSIFS’s Law with Labs® vision—integrating law, technology and forensic science.

This Summit can be a game changer for Uttar Pradesh: connecting classrooms with careers, laboratories with industry, and innovation with legal compliance.

Our ambition: partnerships that create opportunities—and young professionals equipped to lead.
